editorial.title_zh: 印度不锈钢企业人士：应对CBAM先完善排放数据，再推进减碳投资
editorial.title_en: Indian stainless executive argues for better emissions data before larger decarbonisation investment
editorial.summary_zh: Renewable Watch刊发Jindal Stainless管理人员署名观点，建议先完善排放核算，再结合清洁电力、废钢及绿氢推进减碳。这是企业人士的路径建议，不是新的欧盟法规。
editorial.summary_en: A signed Renewable Watch opinion by a Jindal Stainless executive prioritises emissions accounting alongside clean power, scrap and hydrogen. It is a corporate viewpoint, not a new EU rule.
editorial.impact_zh: 业务判断：可用于观察印度同行的竞争策略。文中成本、默认值及减排比例未作独立法规核验，不直接用于首钢报价或CBAM费用计算。
editorial.impact_en: Business assessment: useful for monitoring Indian competitors. Article cost, default-value and reduction estimates are not independently validated for Shougang pricing or CBAM calculations.
editorial.follow_up: 跟进同行实际排放核验能力与产品结构；涉及报价的参数另查官方文件。
editorial.coverage: 已阅读11月10日署名原文；仅提炼作者建议，不确认其法规参数、成本数字或技术减排预测。

editorial.title_zh: 中国日报报道钢铁节能进展：行业数据不能替代产品碳排放证据
editorial.title_en: China Daily reports steel-sector energy savings; aggregate progress is not product emissions evidence
editorial.summary_zh: 中国日报11月13日报道，中钢协人士在10月28日论坛介绍行业能效提升与低碳技术进展。报道反映行业与企业转型，不是新的贸易措施。
editorial.summary_en: China Daily reports on 13 November remarks at an industry forum on 28 October about energy efficiency and low-carbon steel technology. This is industry progress, not a new trade measure.
editorial.impact_zh: 业务判断：可作为客户沟通的行业背景；具体钢厂、工艺和产品的排放证据仍需单独提供，不能用行业整体减排成绩替代订单数据。
editorial.impact_en: Business assessment: useful context for customers. Mill, process and product emissions evidence remains separate from aggregate industry progress.
editorial.follow_up: 销售材料区分行业统计、钢厂实测和产品核验结果。
editorial.coverage: 已读取中国日报原始报道；按原站发布日期纠正RSS的11月12日观察日期。未独立审计报道引用的行业减排统计。
